name: Liberty Boys
description: The Liberty Boys were a New York street gang active in the 1950s, based around the corner of Liberty Avenue and Pennsylvania Avenue in Brooklyn/Queens. They were rivals of the Roman Lords, a Puerto Rican gang, and are documented in a memoir by Roman Lords member Efraim Ruiz describing a violent clash in which the Roman Lords attacked the Liberty Boys at their clubhouse on that corner.
